name: Catalonia Bayahibe
description:
Heaven on earth exists and it is in the Dominican Republic. Come and discover it at the Catalonia Bayahibe hotel! Our fabulous all-inclusive resort stands on one of the country's leading beaches, awarded the International Blue Flag and surrounded by leafy tropical gardens that will leave you with the feeling you’re in Eden. La Romana International Airport is just 20 minutes by car and half an hour away by boat are the famous virgin islands of Saona and Catalina. 
With a large central pool and over 300 rooms, our hotel is the perfect place for your holidays, where you will have everything you need to enjoy life to the full: buffets, themed restaurants, activities for all ages, a spa, water sports, nightly shows and much more. Marvel at the Caribbean’s most stunning sunsets while sipping a cocktail at the Catalonia Bayahibe resort. 
In a small fishing village, very close to La Romana, is one of the most beautiful beaches in the country: Playa de Bayahíbe. Its crystalline waters and white sand are of extraordinary beauty. In addition, it has been awarded the International Blue Flag, a recognition that only the best beaches in the world receive, based on criteria such as water quality, responsible environmental management, safety or the environmental education it offers. Its paradisiacal landscape will surprise you, it is undoubtedly one of the most incredible places in the Dominican Republic. Within this framework, the Catalonia Bayahibe hotel has received the Green Globe Certificate, which certifies our commitment to preserving the magnificent natural environment that surrounds the resort.
Whether you come to spend your holidays with family, friends or as a couple, we have rooms for all tastes. Distributed in two-story villas fully integrated with the landscape, all rooms have a balcony or terrace from where you can contemplate the lush tropical vegetation. If you are planning your honeymoon, we have designed our Privileged romance deluxe room in great detail so that you can spend unforgettable days with special services such as a romantic dinner or couples massage.
In addition to bathing on the beach, at the Catalonia Bayahibe resort you will find a huge central pool with different areas including a jacuzzi, a children's pool and an activity area. Next to it is El Merenguero, the main bar of the complex where you can refresh yourself with cocktails, smoothies and cold drinks, although, if you prefer not to have to get out of the water, Margarita's Swim-Up Bar is your best option. Fancy a piece of wood-fired pizza while you sunbathe on the sun lounger? Come to the Snack Bar & Pizza and indulge yourself without leaving the pool area.
When it comes to breakfast, lunch and dinner, we have everything prepared to satisfy your most gourmet side with a great gastronomic offer that will make you vibrate. Taste local and international cuisine in open buffet format at the Taino restaurant or at the Sorrento pizzeria, for dinner choose from our à la carte themed restaurants. Among the latter, you cannot miss Yuca, specialized in Caribbean cuisine from different countries, where you will try the tastiest Dominican, Cuban, and Jamaican dishes, among others. We also have restaurants from different parts of the world, such as Spanish-inspired with tapas, American cuisine or Italian cuisine.
The Catalonia Bayahibe resort is much more than the beach, swimming pool and gastronomy, we want you to have an unbeatable holiday and that is why we offer you an extensive leisure and entertainment program for all ages. The little ones will have fun in our Kid's Club, with activities created especially for them. Meanwhile, you can choose between relaxing with a massage at the Alegría Spa, dance classes or practicing water sports such as snorkeling, scuba diving or kayaking. In addition, you can practice your swing at our golf course just 50 minutes away by car.
Do you dream of getting married or renewing your vows in paradise? Make it happen on the hotel's white sand beach with the help of our events team, who will organize everything you need. In addition, at Alegría Spa we have a make-up and hairdressing service so that you shine on your big day.
If you love discovering the best places in the countries to which you travel, from the Catalonia Bayahibe hotel you can visit some of the must-sees of the Dominican Republic, such as the virgin islands of Catalina and Saona, with fascinating vegetation and fauna, or the Parque Nacional del Este, home to the Taíno Indians, the first inhabitants of the island.
So far we can tell you, if you want to discover the rest, think no more and come spend your vacation at the Catalonia Bayahibe resort.

name: Iberostar Selection Coral Bavaro All Inclusive
description: Welcome to a world of unparalleled sophistication and exclusivity where your dream Caribbean escape awaits. Nestled within an family friendly oasis, Iberostar Selection Coral Bávaro exudes an air of class that's simply unmatched. With its charming Caribbean-style village appearance, a stunning beachfront location that beckons you to dip your toes in the azure waters, and a myriad of Instagram-worthy photo opportunities, this hotel promises a vacation experience like no other.

name: Catalonia Bávaro Resort
description:
We have the holidays you dream of: come and discover the Caribbean paradise of Dominican Republic at the Catalonia Bavaro hotel. An all-inclusive resort in Cabeza de Toro, one of the premier beach zones in the country and just 20 km from Punta Cana airport. Suites and junior suites in a complex of villas surrounded by tropical vegetation, lakes and a pool with a swim-up bar. 
From the time you set foot in the hotel you will have everything you need for an exceptional holiday. Savour our extensive gastronomic offering in buffets and international a la carte restaurants, as well as cocktails and tropical juices under the palms at the resort bars. We will help you relax even more at the Alegría Spa, plus we have an extensive range of programmes so you can enjoy our sports, cultural and night-time leisure activities featuring outdoor performances. 
Bathing in incredible white sand beaches and crystal clear waters surrounded by coral reefs, sunbathing under the palm trees and enjoying an ideal temperature throughout the year, all of this is possible at the Catalonia Bávaro hotel. The huge resort complex houses 682 all-inclusive junior suite and suite rooms, which are distributed in beautiful villas surrounded by lakes and tropical gardens.
Whichever room you choose, you will be welcomed by its decoration with subtle Caribbean touches and you will fall in love with its terrace or balcony from where you can admire the outdoor vegetation. If you want to experience the most exclusive vacation, opt for one of our Privileged rooms. In them, in addition to the all-inclusive package, you will enjoy many other unique advantages, such as access to a private beach for Privileged guests with Balinese beds, late check out until 3 pm (subject to availability) and discounts on activities and treatments.
Your vacation will be full of flavor thanks to our wide gastronomic offer, you have many restaurants to choose from! Enjoy 2 international buffet restaurants, Gran Caribe open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, or La Palapa, a spot near the beach open for breakfast and midday. You'll also find à la carte restaurants where you can experience culinary delights from around the world, such as the Mamma Mia pizzeria, the Japanese Ayami, or the American-style restaurant Steakville, among others.
Is there anything better than enjoying a cocktail while relaxing on the sand or in the pool? At the Catalonia Bávaro hotel you will hardly have to move to get yours in one of our bars on the beach, such as Pleamar or Beach Bar. If you prefer a freshly squeezed juice of the juiciest tropical fruits you will find it in Maloo Bar and if you have craving to eat something delicious on the deck chair, in our Creperie you can order your favorite sweet or savory crepes.
Come to the Pearl Beach Club, the most exclusive beach club in the Caribbean that you can come to whether you are a guest of the Catalonia Bávaro hotel or not. Bathe in our infinity pool with views of the sea, taste Mediterranean, Asian and tropical fusion dishes, live live DJ performances and have a drink watching the sunset.
We want you to relax during your vacation, that's why our Alegría Spa has a sauna and a wide variety of massages and treatments so you can connect with your inner self while you're in paradise. Also, if you don't want to lose your training routine, in our gym you will find state-of-the-art machines to keep you in shape.
At the Catalonia Bávaro resort you will never get bored, as our entertainment team has prepared activities and workshops for all tastes: archery, petanque, aquagym in the pool, merengue classes and much more. You can also practice sports such as tennis, beach volleyball, golf, paddle tennis or start scuba diving. At night, continue the fun by dancing in the disco, gambling in the casino or enjoying our outdoor night shows.
If you have an important event on your calendar, do not hesitate to come and celebrate it at the Catalonia Bávaro hotel, where we have 2 meeting rooms with a capacity of up to 350 people together. Ideal to celebrate your wedding with a large banquet, a birthday, a graduation, etc., in all cases, attendees will enjoy a great evening in an incomparable setting.
Although you will have everything you want on your vacation within the resort, you can also take excursions to nearby points of interest in the Dominican Republic, such as the adventure theme park La Hacienda Park, the Basílica de la Altagracia in the town of Higüey or the Fortress of Ozama, one of the most famous monuments in the capital, Santo Domingo.
Make your dream vacation come true at the Catalonia Bávaro Beach, Golf & Casino Resort hotel!

name: Secrets La Romana Resort & Spa
description: Just steps from an eco-friendly secluded beach overlooking the glittering Caribbean Sea, Secrets La Romana Resort & Spa whisks travelers into an adults-only retreat for limitless serenity. Get your fill of sunshine with two outdoor pools, the luxurious day spa and outdoor dining. With unparalleled activities, the resort is home to a Five-Star Dive Center, water sports and a lively casino. Our Unlimited-Luxury® experience allows you to maximize every moment of relaxation and romance in an all-inclusive setting. This resort is now part of the World of Hyatt loyalty program.

name: JOIA Bavaro by Iberostar All Inclusive
description:
Welcome to JOIA Bávaro by Iberostar, where artistry, nature, and Caribbean spirit come beautifully together.
Located along the soft white sands of one of the Caribbean’s most celebrated beaches, this adults-only, all-suite retreat is crafted for pure indulgence. Stroll through lush gardens filled with native plants and original sculptures, unwind across three shimmering pools with sweeping ocean views, and discover a world of flavor with seven exceptional restaurants, including a bar in a replica Spanish galleon unlike anything else on the island.
Every suite is designed for effortless comfort, featuring airy open spaces, swing hammocks, Jacuzzi baths, and personal butler service. Beyond your door, a world-class spa and an 18-hole championship golf course designed by P.B. Dye await your next moment of escape.
Whether you're savoring sunset cocktails, wandering beneath the palms, or reconnecting in serene spaces, JOIA Bávaro invites you to settle into a rhythm that's timeless, joyful, and uniquely yours.

name: Catalonia Royal Bávaro - Adults Only
description:
The best of the Caribbean is waiting for you at the Catalonia Royal Bavaro - Adults Only hotel, an all-inclusive resort for people over 18. You will enjoy a true paradise, with white sand beaches, an infinity pool, an extensive gastronomic offering and leisure activities that are fun and a good way to de-stress. All of this in a place of unsurpassed beauty in the area of Cabeza de Toro, just 20 km from Punta Cana airport. 

Choose your room from among our suites and junior suites, some with a private pool you can access straight from your terrace and others with stunning ocean views. Wake up each morning knowing you are going to have an incredible day enjoying cocktails in our bars, swimming in the crystal clear Caribbean sea, relaxing at the Alegría Spa and enjoying dishes from around the world in our restaurants. What more could you want?  

If you are looking for a place to disconnect, have fun, practice sports, discover a new country and meet new people, the Catalonia Royal Bávaro - Adults Only hotel is what you are looking for. An adults-only resort that has everything for your vacation on one of the best-rated beaches in the Dominican Republic.

For your rest, our suite and junior suite rooms await you with a large king-size bed where you will sleep like on clouds. All are decorated in an elegant colonial style with wooden furniture and most have a Jacuzzi in the room, as well as a bathroom with a shower. The Privileged deluxe junior suite & swimming pool and the Privileged duplex suite & swimming pool have a terrace with a private pool and, in addition, the latter is distributed over two floors, with a living room on the ground floor and a bedroom on the upper floor.

If you choose one of our Privileged rooms you will enjoy incredible benefits during your stay, such as access to the private beach only for Privileged guests, priority in all the resort's restaurants, discounts on extra services such as golf, romantic dinners and treatments in our Alegría Spa.

As for gastronomy, without leaving the Catalonia Royal Bávaro - Adults Only hotel you can take a journey through the flavors of the world, Tao Cat will take you to Asia with its innovative proposals, at Siwichi you will taste true à la carte Peruvian cuisine , you will find the best wood-fired pizzas at the Sorrento pizzeria and the most popular Catalan vegetarian dishes will captivate you at Barcelona Origens. Of course, you also have complete buffets of international cuisine for your breakfasts, lunches and dinners. On the other hand, our bars by the pool or on the beach are open until night so you can enjoy drinks and snacks whenever you feel like it.

Spend the day at our large pool and order your favorite cocktails at Margarita's Swim-Up Bar to enjoy in the water or on the sun loungers. You can also opt for our infinity pool, very close to the beach, or relax with the hydromassage in the outdoor jacuzzis. If you want to make your day in Bávaro even more special, just 2 km away you will find the exclusive Pearl Beach Club. This beach club has a privileged location and you will enjoy live music performances, a restaurant, cocktail bar and an infinity pool with Balinese beds and views of the Caribbean Sea.

Even when you are in paradise, you deserve to give yourself a moment just for you, come to our Alegría Spa, with sauna, Turkish bath and massage service and body rituals. We offer them both in our cabins and in the palapas next to the beach, so you can disconnect from everything in an incomparable setting.

Your stay at the Catalonia Royal Bávaro hotel gives you access to the Catalonia Bávaro Resort family hotel, located right next door. The entertainment team organizes all kinds of activities for you to have fun during the day and night, from tropical dance classes to native painting workshops, disco, outdoor shows and more. You can also practice your favorite sports such as tennis, golf or paddle tennis and start scuba diving or use a catamaran.

If you love golf, you'll be delighted to know that at the Catalonia Royal Bávaro - Adults Only hotel, you can play at the Catalonia Cabeza de Toro Golf Club, which has 9 holes. On the other hand, if you want to continue your exercise routine while you're on vacation, our gym has weights and cardio machines.

Come celebrate your wedding in an idyllic setting and get married on the beach feeling the Caribbean breeze. We have two large event rooms ideal for banquets that we will decorate to your liking, taking care of all the details so that your big day is as you have always imagined.

name: Dreams Dominicus La Romana
description: A luxurious family vacation or romantic getaway at the all-new beachfront Dreams Dominicus La Romana offers 488 spacious guestrooms and suites set in Bayahibe - an ideal location to explore the region, or to just enjoy some rest and relaxation in the Dominican Republic. There's something for everyone at Dreams Dominicus La Romana, and best of all, it is all included with Unlimited-Luxury® .

name: Catalonia Royal La Romana Adult Only All Inclusive
description:
Catalonia Royal La Romana Adults Only Hotel
Immerse yourself in the pleasure of travelling to the Caribbean at a 5-star resort such as the Catalonia Royal La Romana – Adults Only. An exclusive design hotel only for adults over 18 years old and recognized with the AAA 4 Diamond award. Located in the town of La Romana, it sits on the prime beach of Bayahíbe and is just 20 minutes away from the nearest international airport. 
Choose one of our swim-up rooms and you will be able to directly jump into the pool from your private terrace or revel in the delights of a private pool in the splendid duplex suites. Get set for cutting-edge gastronomic experiences in our restaurants and kick back while you drink a cocktail overlooking the turquoise waters of the Caribbean. Enjoy a relaxing massage, sports you never get the chance to play and one of the most colourful sunsets in the world. 
The Catalonia Royal La Romana – Adults Only resort is endorsed by the American Automobile Association (AAA) with the 4 Diamonds distinction, recognizing the excellence of our service in exclusive stays for adults only. In addition to enjoying the modern facilities of the hotel, such as a pool with a swim-up bar and a solarium with Balinese beds, you will have unlimited access to all Privileged services at our Catalonia Bayahibe hotel. Located right next door, it offers a private beach only for Privileged guests, preferential access to restaurants, and discounts on spa treatments, among other benefits. We also encourage you to participate in the activities and workshops organized by our entertainment team, from dance classes to live nightly performances and weekly theme parties.
Among the 141 rooms at the Catalonia Royal La Romana – Adults Only resort, you will undoubtedly find your favourite. All are spacious, bright and have a clean design in which white predominates combined with touches of Caribbean colors such as green, pink or blue. Each one of them has its own character, but, without a doubt, the most unique rooms are the superior swim up, the superior junior suite swim up and the deluxe romance swim up, since all three have a private terrace from which you can dive to the resort pool. Special mention deserves our fabulous duplex & swimming pool suite with 2 floors that include a living room, bedroom, toilet and a large bathroom with a double shower, as well as a spectacular terrace with a private pool and sun loungers where you can tan without anyone or anything bothering you. .
Your extraordinary Caribbean vacation continues with a select culinary experience in our restaurants. Do not miss the BLoved restaurant, with an eclectic gastronomy proposal that combines Caribbean cuisine with international touches. If you prefer Asian food, Tao-Cat is your restaurant, also try the Peruvian dishes at Siwichi or savor the most traditional Italian lasagna in our La Toscana restaurant.
If you prefer to eat something quickly to continue enjoying the beach or the pool, at La Isla Snack Bar you will find the most popular international dishes and, if you don't want to get out of the water to have a piña colada or your favorite cocktail, all you have to do is swim to the Pool Bar Aqua.
Practice your swing at the Catalonia golf courses located 50 minutes from Bayahíbe, get fit in the gym or try new sports, such as aquagym or initiation to scuba diving in our pool. To completely relax, in our Alegría Spa we have a wide variety of massages, body and facial beauty treatments that we also offer outdoors.
If this year is your year, why not celebrate your wedding and honeymoon at a resort as exclusive as the Catalonia Royal La Romana – Adults Only? We have incredible and modern facilities, as well as a highly qualified team that will make sure to plan down to the last detail to guarantee that you spend an unforgettable day.
Did you know that the Dominican Republic was the first place where Christopher Columbus docked in the discovery of the Americas? For this reason, it has a great historical legacy that you cannot miss during your vacation on the island. Especially in the capital, Santo Domingo, located just an hour and a half by car from the hotel, you can visit emblematic places such as Parque Colón, the Museum of the Royal Houses, the Ozama Fortress or the San Francisco Monastery. Although you will not need to leave the hotel to enjoy Dominican wonders such as Bayahíbe Beach, awarded with the International Blue Flag, a certification based on criteria such as water quality or environmental management that recognize it as one of the best in the country. .
Practice your Swing
If you’re passionate about golf, you’ll find the Cabeza de Toro Golf Club near the resort, where you can play during your vacation. The hotel provides all the necessary equipment to enjoy this sport (transport to the course not included).

description:
Enjoy a romantic getaway on one of the most beautiful beaches in Punta Cana. Our adults-only (18+) all-inclusive resort is the perfect retreat to rediscover love in a heavenly setting. Tropical nature blends seamlessly with our Wellness-Inclusive facilities, meticulously designed to enhance your rest and relaxation.
Discover Meliá Punta Cana Beach, an exclusive five-star resort located in the heavenly setting of Playa Bávaro, an ideal environment for honeymoon couples. Discover the benefits of The Level, surround yourself with the serenity of our facilities and enjoy exquisite dining options, a YHI Spa, several swimming pools and Wellness-Inclusive rooms. Furthermore, our world-class golf facilities complete a perfect stay in the Caribbean.

name: Nickelodeon Hotels & Resorts Punta Cana by Karisma
description:
Discover a New Kind of All-Ages Vacation in Punta Cana
Family adventures are better together, and at Nickelodeon Hotels & Resorts Punta Cana, fun has no age limit. Explore our Aqua Nick® waterpark in search of a splashin' good time. Roam around our Gourmet Village for delicious drinks and diverse bites. Meet up with some of your favorite Nickelodeon characters and enjoy our themed events. There's plenty of fun in store for the entire bunch when you check into Nickelodeon Hotels & Resorts Punta Cana — all on the golden sands of Uvero Alto beach.

name: Ocean El Faro All Inclusive
description:
Ocean El Faro Resort - All Inclusive Punta Cana
The Ocean El Faro is a newly built five-star resort located on the seafront overlooking the idyllic beaches of Punta Cana. It features water attractions including large swimming pools, a calm stream with a gentle current, ideal for relaxing and letting go, as well as a family area with a water park. Ocean El Faro is located in the Uvero Alto area. The resort offers spectacular rooms, a wide range of themed restaurants, a Despacio Spa Centre, Privilege, Exclusive Rooms and Services and a full programme of entertainment for the whole family. In May 2019, the hotel will open an exclusive area for guests 18 and over with specialized services and leisure activities.
Wonderful facilities and services on the seafront at Punta Cana
Located on the seafront overlooking the idyllic beaches of Punta Cana, the Ocean El Faro is a newly built five-star resort with impressive colonial-style interior design. It stands out for its elegant rooms, large swimming pools, a lazy river with a gentle current, a family area with water park and El Faro, which gives the hotel its name and offers a viewpoint with spectacular views of the sea. In addition, the resort has a wide range of themed restaurants, a Despacio Spa Centre and Privilege, Exclusive Rooms and Services. Ocean El Faro has an exclusive area for guests 18 and over, El Beso, with a wide range of services and leisure activities designed for adults. It is the perfect place for those seeking an exclusive environment for relaxing as a couple or having a good time with friends.

name: Ocean El Faro - El Beso Adults Only All inclusive
description:
ENJOY OUR ADULTS ONLY EXPERIENCE
El Beso Adults Only at Ocean El Faro, is an exclusive area with it's very own swimming pool, restaurants and beach areas; It is the perfect place for those seeking a peaceful environment for relaxing as a couple or having a good time with friends, El Beso guests can as well enjoy all the facilities of the family section from the resort with no extra cost.
Wonderful facilities and services on the seafront at Punta Cana
Ocean El Faro El Beso Adults Only is an Adults Only area with exclusive access for El Beso guests, featuring a pool, beach area, restaurants, and bars located within the Ocean El Faro resort. It is the ideal place for those seeking a peaceful atmosphere to relax as a couple or have fun with friends. Ocean El Faro is a new five-star resort located on the seafront of the paradisiacal beaches of Punta Cana. Guests staying in the El Beso Adults Only area can enjoy the rest of the resort's facilities and services: a wide range of themed restaurants, a Despacio Spa Centre ($), Privilege Service ($), Exclusive Rooms and Services ($), and El Faro, which gives the hotel its name and offers an observation deck with spectacular sea views. Resort area recommended for adults over 18 years of age and with exclusive access for El Beso guests.

name: Lopesan Costa Bávaro Resort Spa & Casino
description: Lopesan Costa Bavaro Resort Spa & Casino is a hotel located at Punta Cana, in the Dominican Republic. The beach with its white sand and turquoise water, the island's tropical climate which is warm all year round, and the abundance of lush greenery all come together to create a truly unique spot and a real treat for the senses. Spread over more than 100, 000 m2 and boasting 5 stars, the hotel has many green areas and 6 freshwater swimming pools. One of these is the popular infinity pool, which has two levels - one at the height of the hotel and the other connected to the beach itself, thus linking the beach and hotel. There is also a pool for kids. The Resort also stands out thanks to its impressive all-inclusive range of culinary options, which cater for all tastes. In addition to 2 buffets which offer international, national and regional cuisine, guests can also take their pick from Mexican, Mediterranean or Asian food, or head to the Steak House, a typical Italian trattoria or an American Grill. Also not to be forgotten are the hotel's 2 beach clubs, the lobby bar and its 4 pool bars. Fun and entertainment are guaranteed at this spectacular Caribbean resort thanks to its outstanding range of sports activities, such as scuba diving, windsurf, sailing and water skiing. The entertainment team organizes various group competitions, games and activities, meaning guests have the chance to meet new people and really have the holiday of a lifetime. The Boulevard is the area's best place for shopping and entertainment: An impressive casino, wellness center, discotheque, bowling alleys, kids and teens facilities, shops of the most exclusive brands and numerous restaurants are only few of the leisure options offered by this hotel.

name: Catalonia Punta Cana
description: A magnificent hotel resort with private white sandy beaches, crystalline Caribbean waters, palm trees lining the coast and abundant vegetation throughout the complex. It is located approximately 16 km from Punta Cana International Airport, 19 km from the Manati Park nature preserve and zoo and 39 km from shopping in Higuey. The hotel offers a wide range of facilities, including 1 Golf camp, nightclub, a casino and tennis courts. Its large freeform pool area contains islands, fountains, and a man-made beach. The hotel offers a unique travel experience.

name: Excellence Punta Cana
description: Indulge in a full-service spa offering body treatments and facials. Enjoy four outdoor swimming pools, two spa tubs, and a private beach. This all-inclusive Colonial property provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and gift shops. An area shuttle is available (surcharge). Rates cover meals and beverages at on-site restaurants, though some dining experiences may incur extra charges. Savor Mexican cuisine at Agave, one of the eleven restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Snacks are available at the coffee shop/cafe. Refreshments can be found at the swim-up bar, twelve bars/lounges, or three poolside bars. The property features limo/town car service, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Roundtrip airport shuttle service is available (surcharge, 24 hours), and free self-parking is provided. Each of the 461 guestrooms includes minibars, LED TVs, private furnished balconies or patios, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. Private bathrooms offer separate bathtubs and showers with jetted tubs and rainfall showerheads. Nearby attractions include Sirenis Aquagames Water Park (1. 5 mi), Macao Beach (8. 2 mi), and Cana Bay Golf Club (13. 5 mi).

description: The Westin Punta Cana Resort is part of the 15,000-acre Punta Cana Resort and Club, which boasts 3 miles of white-sand beaches. Nearby are two championship golf courses, a range of water activities, a shopping village and world-class restaurants. Rejuvenate with a spa visit, energize at our WestinWORKOUT® Fitness Studio, or refresh by the open-air pool and enjoy wholesome cuisine at the adjacent grill. Gather in style in the unforgettable meeting and wedding facilities of our Punta Cana Resort Club at our hotel in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. All 200 guest rooms, including 16 suites, feature contemporary decor and private balconies with soothing views of lush gardens or the Caribbean Sea. Our beachfront hotel in Punta Cana is perfect for a couple's getaway. Renew your senses with the revitalizing Heavenly Shower and experience pure refreshment in the Heavenly Bed at The Westin Punta Cana Resort.

description: Amid the beauty of Playa Macao, Dreams Macao Beach Punta Cana also provides activities and entertainment for guests of all ages, including kids and teens with the supervised Explorer's Club for Kids and Core Zone Teens Club. The ultimate aqua-fun experience can be found at the water park which includes slides, a lazy river and more. name: Sunscape Dominicus La Romana
description: Set along the golden sand beaches of Playa Dominicus, Bayahibe, Sunscape Dominicus La Romana Resort & Spa offers an exciting retreat for families and adults. The resort is conveniently located only 12 miles from La Romana International Airport and 44 miles from Punta Cana International Airport, set in the heart of the Hotel Zone. The property boasts 854 well-appointed guestrooms, Junior Suites and Family Villas offering a private furnished balcony with stunning views of the beach. Sunscape Dominicus La Romana treats families, couples and singles to an Unlimited-Fun® getaway where everything is included. Take advantage of the Explorer’s Club for Kids ages 3 - 12, the Core Zone Teens’ Club for ages 13-17, daily supervised land and water activities, live music and local entertainment, reservation-free dining options, bars serving international and domestic brand beverages and much more! description: Perfectly situated in the exclusive gated community of Cap Cana, Secrets Cap Cana Resort & Spa will bring the highest level of luxury to the crystal blue waters and magnificent sugar-sand Juanillo Beach, one of the Dominican Republic's most beautiful beaches.  Luxe and superior, Secrets Cap Cana is the epitome of luxury while offering guests the Unlimited-B15 experience, where everything is included, such as unlimited gourmet dining, limitless top-shelf spirits, 24-hour room and concierge services, a daily refreshed mini-bar and so much more. At Secrets Cap Cana, just 20 minutes from Punta Cana International Airport, guests will enjoy 457 suites adorned with sophisticated Caribbean furnishings, striking marble bathrooms and a furnished balcony or terrace with stunning views of the ocean or lush surroundings. Free Wi-Fi and international calling allows guests to stay connected to those they are with, as well as friends and family back home.  Eight restaurants, seven of which are à la carte, will offer gourmet fare from a variety of cuisines while six bars and lounges pour unlimited top-shelf spirits.  Guests can also spend a night out at a neighboring resort with the Sip, Savor & See dining experience.

name: Tropical Deluxe Princess
description: This popular hotel is located on the beach of Playa Bavaro. The airport of Punta Cana is about 20 km away whilst the Plaza Bavaro with its countless shops, bars, restaurants, clubs and pubs as well as various other entertainment venues is only 20 minutes' walk from the hotel. Guests will be thrilled with the comfortable rooms that are colourful and decorated in a Caribbean style. In the outdoor complex there is a pool area with a children's paddling area, a poolside snack bar as well as sun loungers and parasols laid out, allowing guests to soak up the sun. Sports enthusiasts will be spoilt for choice by the activities which this establishment offers such as beach volleyball, basketball, windsurfing and sailing.

name: Bahía Príncipe Escape Aquamarine
description: Located in Punta Cana, this elegant hotel is exclusively for adults. Travelers can find the nearest golf course just steps from the hotel. Public transport is 10. 0 km away. The facility is right on the beach. Guests can reach the airport in 30. 0 km. The hotel has 498 guest rooms. This facility was built in 2015. If you are not an animal lover, you will enjoy your stay, because it is a non-pet-friendly facility. The car park can be useful for anyone arriving by car. Visitors can relax and recharge their batteries in the existing health and wellness facilities. Bahía Príncipe Escape Aquamarine prides itself on its various restaurants that serve first-class specialties. The establishment's restaurant offers delicious cuisine and first class service. The entertainment program at the facility ensures that there is no boredom. For those who love sports and those who want an active stay, there is a full program of organized activities. Fees may apply for some of the aforementioned services.

name: Bahía Príncipe Explore Punta Cana
description: This outstanding resort is perched on the gorgeous white sand beach in the Bavaro area of Punta Cana, where the opulent surroundings combine with stunning natural scenery. This imposing property is a perfect choice for all those looking to feel the sea breeze and the freshness of the natural surroundings by strolling through the numerous tropical gardens. The visitors will be immersed in unparalleled luxury, starting with delightful facilities, high quality accommodation, exceptional services and leisure activities. The rooms are sumptuously designed and come complete with cutting-edge amenities. The complex will spoil travellers with a wide selection of tantalizing Mediterranean, Japanese, Italian, Mexican, gourmet, seafood, grill specialties served at the on-site dining venues. The youngest ones may play at the kids' club while adults work out at the gym, while away at the bar or treat themselves to ultimate rejuvenation with massage at the on-site spa.

name: Princess Family Club Bavaro
description: This outstanding hotel, located in Bavaro, offers 161 welcoming accommodations, providing the perfect retreat after a long day. Highlights include spacious family rooms, some with direct pool access, and a new recreation area featuring a water park with slides, a dedicated snack bar, and a children's pool bar.

description: Located on the east coast of the Dominican Republic, between Santo Domingo and La Romana, this splendid holiday resort is surrounded by coconut palms and overlooks a beautiful bay. The Pueblo Príncipe, a Caribbean-style shopping and leisure center at the entrance of the hotel area, offers night entertainment, shopping, and a 24-hour burger bar. All rooms feature air conditioning, a bathroom with a hydromassage tub, jet shower, and hairdryer, as well as satellite television, a direct telephone line, and a minibar. Guests can enjoy the swimming pool (with a separate children's pool), work out in the gym, or relax in the sauna. The fully air-conditioned, non-smoking restaurant offers breakfast, lunch, and dinner buffets.

name: Bahía Príncipe Explore Esmeralda
description: When you stay at the all-inclusive Bahía Príncipe Explore Esmeralda, you'll be on the beach, within a 15-minute walk of Arena Gorda Beach and Punta Blanca Golf Course. Complimentary Wi-Fi keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms include separate bathtubs and showers, jetted bathtubs, and rainfall showerheads. Your all-inclusive rate covers meals and beverages at onsite dining establishments. Charges may apply for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. All-inclusive rates are available, covering meals and beverages at on-site dining establishments. Charges may apply for dining at some restaurants, special dinners and dishes, some beverages, and other amenities. Grab a bite at one of the property's 10 restaurants, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Unwind with a drink at one of the 5 bars/lounges. A complimentary full breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Free valet parking is available on-site.

name: Faranda Single 1 Punta Cana Adults Only
description: Choose Single 1 Punta Cana! More than a place to stay, it is a five-star experience in one of the most paradisiacal destinations in the Caribbean. Our hotel is located very close to one of the most beautiful beaches in the world, with turquoise waters and pearly sand. All rooms are equipped to make you feel at home and their facilities (gym, jogging track, swimming pool, restaurant, yoga space, etc. ) are top-notch. You also have a team of professionals to advise you on aquatic activities or ecotourism tours. We want your stay to be surprising!

name: Ac Hotel By Marriott Punta Cana
description: Stay at the AC Hotel by Marriott Punta Cana and be just a short drive from Bavaro Beach and the San Juan Shopping Center. This hotel offers an outdoor pool, a 24-hour fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and gift shops. The 129 air-conditioned rooms feature LCD TVs, cable programming, and private bathrooms with rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. Enjoy a meal at the AC Kitchen or a drink at the bar/lounge. A continental breakfast is available daily for a fee. Additional amenities include a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and free self-parking.

name: Impressive Punta Cana
description: Located on El Cortecito Beach in Bavaro, this resort offers spacious, modern rooms designed for relaxation. Guests enjoy a wide variety of bars and restaurants, a beautiful beach, extensive gardens, three pools, and a vast selection of day and night activities for all ages. The vibrant colors and stunning views create a unique and enjoyable atmosphere. The all-inclusive service offers diverse dining experiences with à la carte and buffet-style restaurants, featuring a range of culinary delights and international beverages. Guests can also indulge in the Feel Impressive Spa & Wellness, utilize professional wedding and event planning services, and enjoy a full entertainment program.

name: Impressive Premium Punta Cana
description: Nestled on the idyllic El Cortecito beach in Bavaro, this resort offers a privileged Caribbean escape. Enjoy a beautiful beach, extensive gardens, four pool areas, and a wide array of day and night activities for all ages. Rooms accommodate up to four people, with connecting rooms available. The all-inclusive service features diverse à la carte and buffet-style restaurants, serving a variety of culinary delights and international beverages. Guests can also indulge in the Feel Impressive Spa & Wellness, or utilize the professional wedding and event planning services. A dedicated entertainment program ensures a memorable stay.

name: Serenade Punta Cana Beach & Spa Resort
description: Located on the beachfront just 267 meters from the shore, the five-star Serenade Punta Cana Beach & Spa offers 603 luxurious rooms and a wide array of amenities and services. Nestled amidst the Dominican Republic's lush flora, guests can enjoy the magical experience of gentle breezes and white sand on Punta Cana's spectacular beach. Savor exquisite dining, shopping, and spectacular shows, all while experiencing the relaxed Caribbean pace.

name: Viva V Samana By Wyndham, A Trademark Adults All I
description: Viva V Samana by Wyndham is an all-inclusive resort for adults only. Targeted to guests 18 years and older, facing the Caribbean Sea, in a exclusive location, with creative gastronomy and optimal service in a modern day chic atmosphere. The resort is located near Las Terrenas, Samana, a small town on the northeast coast of the Dominican Republic. It is approximately 5 km (3. 1 miles) from the town, 22 km (14 miles) from Samana International Airport, and 136 km (85 miles) from Las Americas International Airport in Santo Domingo.

name: Bahía Príncipe Explore El Portillo
description: This modern hotel is ideally located in Las Terrenas. It is situated close to many attractions in the area, making this a prime option for those who are eager to explore. The hotel is located close to a number of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. This hotel enjoys a tropical style. The guest rooms ooze character and charm, featuring refreshing tones for a peaceful ambiance. The hotel offers many facilities and services which have been designed to enhance any stay. The hotel offers 2 open-air restaurants, where guests can enjoy a traditional dining experience, with sumptuous, local dishes. The hotel also provides a TV room and a hairdressing salon.

name: Serenade All Suites, Adults Only Resort
description: Ideal for beach holidaymakers and active holidaymakers, this resort is situated in a quiet area in Punta Cana, right by the sea. The resort was built recently, in 2023. Guests have a choice of 325 rooms located in two 4-storey buildings. English- and French-speaking staff at the reception desk in the lobby are ready to assist you with check-in and check-out. Amenities at the resort include a baggage storage service. Wireless internet access is provided to guests. Guests can learn more about excursions at the tour desk. The complex has wheelchair-accessible facilities. There are a number of shops as well. A garden provides extra space for rest and relaxation in the open air. Additional facilities include a TV room. A garage is available for parking. Other services include a 24-hour security service, an alarm call service and a hotel doctor. Rooms are equipped with air conditioning and a fan. In most units, guests can enjoy a partial sea view from a balcony or terrace. Many units feature a sea view, which creates a particularly lovely ambience. Rooms have a queen-size bed or a king-size bed. A minibar is provided. An ironing set is provided for guests' convenience. A telephone and WiFi are provided as well. Slippers are included. Bathrooms are equipped with a shower, a bathtub and a whirlpool bath. A hairdryer, a vanity mirror, bathrobes and a telephone are provided. Wheelchair-friendly rooms can be booked. The resort has non-smoking rooms.

name: Zemi Miches Punta Cana Hilton Curio All Inclusive
description: Unlock the hidden treasures of Zemi Miches All-Inclusive Resort, where every moment immerses you in the untouched beauty of a hidden Caribbean paradise, crafting experiences as unique as the island itself. Nestled on the secluded, pristine shores of Playa Esmeralda, our resort seamlessly blends sophisticated design with eco-conscious practices, inviting travelers to discover a truly unique all-inclusive experience. Every aspect of your stay is curated to create lasting memories, intertwining the warmth of Dominican hospitality with bespoke amenities that elevate your senses.

name: Sublime Samana Hotel & Residences
description: Nestled on the Samaná Peninsula in the Dominican Republic, this exclusive collection of suites and private villas sits on the edge of the country's most beautiful beaches, just 1. 5 hours from Las Américas International Airport in Santo Domingo. Surrounded by lush foliage and jungle-covered mountains, guests can enjoy educational excursions and adventures, the beauty of the Caribbean Sea, and personalized service characteristic of a luxury boutique hotel. The spacious suites and villas offer total immersion in the breathtaking ocean views and soothing sounds. Each features floor-to-ceiling windows, private balconies or terraces, elegant furnishings, and fully equipped kitchens. Most accommodations boast stunning sea views. The hotel offers a rustic beach spa and a full spa nestled within the jungle, both incorporating coconut-based treatments for relaxation and rejuvenation. The Bistro, a full-service restaurant, specializes in Mediterranean cuisine, emphasizing fresh seafood. Guests can also enjoy drinks in the adjoining Bistro Lounge. Open daily for breakfast and dinner, the Bistro provides a casual yet elegant dining experience.

name: Eden Roc Cap Cana
description: This resort is situated in the exclusive private community of Cap Cana, on the eastern tip of the Dominican Republic. This magnificent resort tempts visitors into a picture-perfect world rich in luxury and style. The resort is set amidst a 30, 000-acre resort, which is home to pristine beaches, towering cliffs and tropical forests. A Jack Nicklaus signature golf course and a bustling marina are situated nearby. Guests can enjoy a seemingly boundless range of exciting activities nearby. This spectacular destination features sumptuously-designed accommodation options, enveloping visitors in classical style and poise. This resort features an unrivalled range of first-class facilities and services, delivering an unprecedented level of comfort and convenience, along with an unequalled standard of excellence.

name: Tortuga Bay Puntacana Resort & Club
description: Tortuga Bay offers responsible luxury, impeccable service and villas designed by the world-renowned Oscar de la Renta. Hotel has renovation July 16, 2017 - October 15, 2017. Guests must provide a credit card for incidental charges upon check-in. An authorization in the amount of $150 per day will be assessed for incidentals. A cash paying guest must leave a deposit upon arrival in the amount of $150 per day (subject to change) for the duration of their stay.
